crossRefs.note: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
translations.bsb: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
translations.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
translations.asv: Simon Peter therefore went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fishes, a hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, the net was not rent.
